title: Figures 12-13: Hybrid neuro-robotic system - lamprey brainstem controlling Khepera robot
description: Figure 12, "A Hybrid Neuro-Robotic System," diagrams a lamprey brainstem (nOMI, nOMP, PRRN labeled) wired via a variable frequency pulse generator, artifact canceller and spike detection/low-pass filter to a photographed "Khepera mobile robot." Figure 13, "Experimental Arrangements," is a line drawing showing (A) a video camera, amplifiers and recording setup above a tank with a swimming lamprey and (B) a lamprey fixed in a device with electrodes and a manual roll-tilt mechanism. Captions describe light-sensor signals delivered as electrical stimuli and recorded neuronal responses driving the robot's wheels.
